The 2025 disclosure (D557) includes these exact same points in its sentences S001-S002 (oversight structure) and S003-S004 (people management practices and periodic assessments). Since D557 covers both the oversight structure (matching D540) and the people management/assessment details (matching D541), D541 is matched to D557.

comparisons.peer_summary: Citi established the CRM Policy to standardize compliance risk management, with Independent Compliance Risk Management overseeing the policy and businesses responsible for managing their own compliance risks within set appetites.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and Citi explicitly define their governance structure for conduct and compliance risk by aligning oversight processes. JPM states that conduct risk oversight is managed 'in the same manner as Compliance risk,' while Citi establishes a CRM Policy where 'Independent Compliance Risk Management overseeing the policy and businesses responsible for managing their own compliance risks.' Both disclosures highlight a centralized policy framework with distinct oversight roles for compliance functions.

sentences.text: The Firm's oversight and coordination of conduct risk is managed in the same manner as Compliance risk.

ICRM is responsible for oversight of Citi's CRM Policy, while all businesses and global control functions are responsible for managing their compliance risks and operating within the Compliance Risk Appetite.

comparisons.peer_topic: Compliance Risk Management Framework and Objectives
comparisons.peer_summary: The company maintains a Compliance Risk Management Framework overseen by Independent Compliance Risk Management to drive a culture of compliance, oversee integrated risk management, assess risks across geographies, and provide reporting capabilities.
comparisons.comparison: JPM's disclosure references the 'Compliance Risk Management' section for details on conduct risk oversight, indicating a shared framework. Similarly, Citi maintains a proactive 'Compliance Risk Management (CRM) Framework' overseen by Independent Compliance Risk Management (ICRM). Both firms utilize a dedicated compliance risk management framework to drive culture and oversight, with JPM referring to it as the model for conduct risk and Citi defining it as the tool to 'strengthen the compliance risk management culture'.

sentences.text: Refer to Compliance Risk Management on page 157 for further information.

Citi must maintain and execute a proactive Compliance Risk Management (CRM) Framework (as set forth in the CRM Policy) that is designed to manage compliance risk effectively across Citi, with a view to fundamentally strengthen the compliance risk management culture across the lines of defense taking into account Citi's risk governance framework and regulatory requirements.

comparisons.peer_topic: Code of Conduct and Global Conduct Risk Policy
comparisons.peer_summary: The Code of Conduct establishes ethical standards, requiring annual certification from all employees, while the Global Conduct Risk Management Policy provides a framework for managing misconduct risk from employees or contingent workers.
comparisons.comparison: While JPM integrates conduct risk oversight into the compliance risk framework, Goldman Sachs defines compliance risk as inherent in all business activities and manages it via a specific 'Compliance Risk Management Program.' In contrast, Morgan Stanley explicitly distinguishes 'conduct risk' as arising from misconduct and establishes a separate 'Global Conduct Risk Management Policy' alongside its Code of Conduct. This represents a structural difference: JPM and Citi align conduct risk closely with compliance risk governance, whereas MS treats conduct risk as a distinct, albeit related, policy area focused on employee misconduct.

sentences.text: The Firm's oversight and coordination of conduct risk is managed in the same manner as Compliance risk.

The Firm's Global Conduct Risk Management Policy also sets out a consistent global framework for managing conduct risk (i.e., the risk arising from misconduct by employees or contingent workers) and conduct risk incidents at the Firm.
